findings.problem: `cannot read <rel>` does not say whether the main or the track copy was unreadable
findings.scenario: an unreadable main-side target is reported with the same text as an unreadable track file
findings.closure: the refusal names the tree (main or track) of the unreadable file

findings.problem: os.walk has no onerror: an unreadable directory under the track's docs/work/<slug> is skipped silently
findings.scenario: a chmod 000 subdirectory of docs/work/<slug> is left out of the copy-back with no refusal, then removed with the tree
findings.closure: walk refuses an unreadable directory with `cannot read <dir>` before any write
